raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

sgl-router moved from `experimental/sgl-router` to the top-level `sgl-router` in #45414, and the crate never had a CODEOWNERS entry at either location. Add owners so router PRs get routed to the people who maintain it.

## Modifications

Adds these lines to `.github/CODEOWNERS`:

```
/docker/sgl-router.Dockerfile @sherlockwu @Kangyan-Zhou @ShangmingCai
/sgl-router @sherlockwu @Kangyan-Zhou @ShangmingCai @hzh0425
/sgl-router/sgl-kv-indexer @sherlockwu @lixiufei-leo @ShangmingCai @wuyl1 @hzh0425
/sgl-router/src/policies @sherlockwu @ShangmingCai @Bo-Vincent
/sgl-router/src/workers @sherlockwu @AMD-yanfeiwang
/sgl-router/src/protocol @sherlockwu @whybeyoung
```

Owners were picked from the router's merged PR history: the crate root goes to its main authors and reviewers, and the sub-paths go to the contributors who built those areas (bucket/scoring policies, decode gate and dp-rank handling in workers, the Anthropic Messages protocol, and the kv-indexer sub-crate).

## Accuracy Tests

N/A, CODEOWNERS only.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

N/A

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Code Formatting with Pre-Commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-formatting-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests as outlined in the [Running Unit Tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#running-unit-tests-writing-documentation-with-mintlify).
- [x] Update documentation / docstrings / example tutorials as needed, according to [Writing Documentation](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#running-unit-tests-writing-documentation-with-mintlify).
- [x] Provide accuracy benchmarks and e2e serving throughput via pytest.
- [ ] For reviewers: If you haven't made any contributions to this PR and are only assisting with merging the main branch, please remove yourself as a co-author when merging the PR.
- [x] Please feel free to join our Slack channel at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss your PR.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
